_meta.purpose: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard 4.0.3 control catalogue in CatalogFile shape, so applyCatalogFile creates the framework, its requirements, the templates, their requirement links and the pack together.
_meta.why: The templates carried authored task sets that reached no database: the fixture was a bare array that only prisma/seed.ts read, and prod does not run it. Reshaped so scripts/seed-framework-catalogs.ts can deliver them.
_meta.grounding: Requirement titles and summaries come from src/data/libraries/owasp-asvs-4.0.3.yaml so the two cannot drift. Task content is grounded in each template's own description.

framework.name: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard 4.0.3
framework.description: OWASP ASVS 4.0.3 Level 1 — the verification requirements applicable to all applications.

requirements.title: Minimum Password Length
requirements.summary: Require passwords of at least twelve characters so that short, easily guessed secrets are rejected. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Long Passwords Permitted
requirements.summary: Permit long passwords of at least sixty-four characters so users can choose strong passphrases. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: No Silent Truncation
requirements.summary: Do not silently truncate passwords; accept the full secret the user typed or reject it clearly. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Unicode and Spaces Allowed
requirements.summary: Allow spaces and printable Unicode, including emoji, within passwords without stripping meaningful characters. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Users Can Change Password
requirements.summary: Let authenticated users change their password through a supported, self-service flow. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Change Requires Current Password
requirements.summary: Require the current password when changing to a new one so a hijacked session cannot lock out the owner. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Breached Password Screening
requirements.summary: Check chosen passwords against a set of known-breached values and refuse those that appear in it. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Password Strength Guidance
requirements.summary: Provide a strength meter or guidance to help users choose stronger passwords. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: No Arbitrary Composition Rules
requirements.summary: Do not impose composition rules such as mandatory symbol mixes that push users toward predictable patterns. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: No Forced Periodic Rotation
requirements.summary: Do not force periodic password rotation in the absence of evidence of compromise. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Password Managers Supported
requirements.summary: Allow pasting and browser or password-manager autofill so that strong, unique secrets are practical. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Reveal or Show Last Character
requirements.summary: Offer an option to view the entered password or its last character to reduce entry errors. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Anti-Automation on Login
requirements.summary: Apply anti-automation controls such as rate limiting and lockout so that credential guessing is impractical. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Restrict Weak Authenticators
requirements.summary: Limit weak authenticators such as SMS and favour stronger factors, offering users at least one strong option. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Secure Authentication Notifications
requirements.summary: Notify users through a secure channel after significant authentication events such as password or factor changes. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Random Initial Secrets
requirements.summary: Generate initial or temporary passwords with sufficient randomness and expire them after first use. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: No Vendor Default Recovery Secret
requirements.summary: Do not ship default or shared recovery secrets that would grant access out of the box. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: No Password Hints
requirements.summary: Do not store or expose password hints or knowledge-based answers that ease guessing. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Recovery Does Not Reveal Password

requirements.title: No Shared or Default Accounts
requirements.summary: Avoid shared or built-in default accounts such as generic administrator logins. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Notify on Factor Change
requirements.summary: Notify the user when an authentication factor is added, changed, or removed. parent_urn: urn:inflect:req:owasp-asvs-4.0.3:V2 depth: 2 assessable: true

requirements.title: Secure Recovery Mechanism

requirements.title: One-Time Lookup Secrets

requirements.title: No Cleartext Out-of-Band

requirements.title: Out-of-Band Expiry

requirements.title: Single-Use Out-of-Band

requirements.title: Authenticated Out-of-Band Delivery

requirements.title: Time-Based One-Time Passwords

requirements.title: No Session Tokens in URLs

requirements.title: New Token After Authentication

requirements.title: Sufficient Token Entropy

requirements.title: Logout Invalidates Session

requirements.title: Inactivity and Absolute Timeout

requirements.title: SameSite Cookie Attribute

requirements.title: Host-Prefixed Cookies

requirements.title: Path-Scoped Cookies

requirements.title: Non-Manipulable Access Metadata
